notes.title: Lucky Lunar Update is live!
notes.notes:
Hey Weyrdlings!

Happy New Year! 🎉 We hope you had a chance to relax and recharge over the holidays. We’re so glad to start the year together with you and your pets. 💕

Our first update of 2025 is here! This update features a few quality of life improvements, so make sure to check them out!
__________________________________

[h1]1. Lunar New Year M.A.D[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030864/c41cce10f419ddeb0b2e55b7c97c70ab2fc845ef.png[/img]
This update brings new MiniPets, Accessories, and Decorations (M.A.D) just in time for the Lunar New Year. 🏮

[h1]2.  Whistle Controller 😮‍💨[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030864/77b1138f4ef2cc185d2dee4c62df92b2c7005c7e.png[/img]
You can now call your pets to you when they wander too far! With the new Whistle Controller, you can easily call them back to the center of your house. Here’s how it works:

[olist]
[*] [b]Right-click[/b] anywhere and bring up the Radial Controller
[*] [b]Left-click[/b] the whistle icon
[*] Then [b]left-click[/b] anywhere again to call your pets. This will spawn them right back at the center.
[/olist]

[h1]3. IGC Ordering[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030864/fa313ffec93f30c45875be804595f54c248467a1.png[/img]
You can now bring your Weyrdlets to life! This is how you can order a 3D printed collectible of your beloved Weyrdlets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030864/c27cbdabdaa66c7177f2f3c3447318a7334bec10.png[/img]
[olist]

[*] Open the customization menu.
[*] Customize your pet and choose your favorite pose.
[*] Ensure everything you want to print is within the frame.
[*] Press "[b]Order IGC[/b]"
[*] Visit their website to complete your print!
[/olist]

[i]Disclaimer: Weyrdlets is solely a customization and 360-capture hub for IGC. For any issues related to orders such as payment, production, shipping, delivery or if you’d like more information before placing an order, please contact IGC at hello@igc.studio directly for assistance[/i] 

[h1]4. Pet Customization Presets[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030864/f54d27f3d6ed8cf8ddff8a18831092c250dd32fb.png[/img]
We heard you! First was the presets for your islands, now for your pets! You can save your pet's accessory and sticker placements just like how you do it with your island. Presets can also be applied to pets of the same species!

[i]P.S. These presets are only applicable to pets of the same species. Eg., if Preset 1 was on a Wagyu, then you can apply the preset to another Wagyu and not a Mochi or a Gyoza. [/i]
___________________________

We hope you enjoy this new update! There’s so much we’ve got planned for Weyrdlets in 2025 and we hope you’ll stick around to grow with us. Here’s to a fun and creative year ahead!

Hello everyone,

[*] [color=Coral][b]New Microgame - Copy That [/b][/color]: Test your memory with [b]Copy That[/b], a fun and challenging Microgame you can enjoy with your Weyrdlet. To begin, navigate to the [b]Microgames[/b] menu in the Radial Controller, and select the circular icon. Press “Spacebar” to start the game, and input the sequence using the arrow keys on your keyboard, or click on the arrows using the mouse.

[*] [color=Coral][b]New Idle Activity - Reading [/b][/color]: Your Weyrdlets have discovered a love for books! To start this Idle Activity, click the [b]Book[/b] icon in the Idle Activities menu of the Radial Controller.

[hr][/hr] 
[u][h2][b]Changes & Fixes[/b][/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]More Accessory Slots[/b] : Pets can now wear up to 8 accessories.
[*] [b]No More Tool Munching[/b] : Pets will no longer mistakenly eat tools.
[*] [b]Help Button for Build Mode & Pet Customization[/b] : A new help button now offers detailed guidance on using controls in Build Mode and Pet Customization.
[*] [b]Build Mode Update[/b] : The default furniture spawn in Build Mode is now set to frozen, and can be set to gravity-on.
[*] [b]Guide Correction[/b] : Fixed incorrect information regarding pets' favorite food and their luck bonus in the guide.
[*] [b]Water Walking Fixes[/b] : Fixed an issue where pets walk on water.
[*] [b]Scene Transition Fix[/b] : Resolved an issue where changing scenes in windowed mode would revert the game to full screen when in Cozy Island.
[*] [b]Desktop Mode Resolution Fix[/b] : Addressed an issue where Desktop Mode wouldn't stay on top if the resolution was set to anything other than 1920x1080.
[*] [b]Color Preview Adjustment[/b] : The color preview for the bronze variants of the Sports Medal, Trophy, and Laurel has been adjusted.
[*] [b]Network Issues[/b] : Network connectivity-related issues are now handled more gracefully. A close button has been added for when the client is unable to connect to the server for rewards. Players can then reopen the Adventure's discovery event to try claiming the rewards again.
[*] [b]Pet Swimming Boundaries[/b] : Fixed regions where pets swim to ensure they don’t swim beyond the camera’s focus.
[*] [b]Streamlined Steam Signup[/b] : Players no longer need to input their birth date when signing up via Steam.
[*] [b]Hot Corner Update[/b] : Non-interactable icons are now excluded from Hot Corner.
[*] [b]Stay-On-Top Setting[/b] : Introduced a setting that allows the game to stay on top or hide between other focused windows.
[*] [b]UI Enhancements[/b] : Various user interface improvements and tweaks have been made.
[/list]
